India's Forex Reserves See Sharpest Weekly Drop

India's foreign exchange reserves experienced their sharpest weekly decline since November 2024, a fall described as the most significant in two years. The decrease is attributed to the Reserve Bank of India's intervention to support the rupee amidst a stronger dollar and rising US yields.
